answer: Give every identity its own task. The beacon derives each epoch's prompt from the account's key plus a fresh seed, so no two puppets get the same question or required words. A 1,000-puppet farm can't write one answer and echo it with light edits. It must produce 1,000 distinct answers that pass grading, which takes about the same compute and attention as 1,000 honest agents. Each extra clone costs as much as the last one, so the spiral of cheap clones stops. Past that horizon, a puppet earns only what its own work earns.
